title: Paired drawers: Peak ticket
topics: Two pointers, windows and prefix sums
summary: The input contains exactly two sorted drawers. Produce all their readings in one sorted sequence, preserving duplicates. Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative.
descriptionMd:
Two sorted dispatch trays must feed one shared label printer without losing repeated tags. Tomas is setting the upper stop on an old office gauge. The largest derived reading goes on its label, even if the whole tray is below zero.

The input contains exactly two sorted drawers. Produce all their readings in one sorted sequence, preserving duplicates.

Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative.

Implement pairedDrawersPeakTicket(drawers, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.
unitIntro: Two sorted streams. The input contains exactly two sorted drawers. Produce all their readings in one sorted sequence, preserving duplicates. Keep the sequence order specified here before computing the requested receipt. A scan invariant says what has been processed and what remains. Work through the proof strip first, then change the returned summary without changing the definition of that sequence. The last card revisits loop accumulators from Hello, Keys.
constraints: 1 <= k <= 8. All arithmetic results fit a signed 32-bit integer.
Numeric readings lie between -1,000,000 and 1,000,000, subject to the task's shape and ordering rules.
The input has exactly two rows, each containing at most 50000 integers.

Target time O(n); auxiliary space including the derived sequence O(n). n is the input length; d distinct values; q query count; M maximum reading; V vertices; E edges; h tree height; r reported tree nodes.
hints: Start with two sorted streams. What state describes the portion you have already processed?

The input contains exactly two sorted drawers. Produce all their readings in one sorted sequence, preserving duplicates. Derive each required reading once; do not restart the whole procedure for every output position.
Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative. Handle the empty derived sequence according to the stated return rule.

cases.explanation: The derived sequence is [-3,0,7,7,12]. Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative. This gives 12.
The derived sequence is [-2,4,4,4,9]. Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative. This gives 9.
The derived sequence is []. Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative. This gives 0.
